spans.s: खिद् (I) vi. 6P (pp. खिन्न; pres. खिंदति) To strike, to afflict.

खिद् (II) vt. or vi. 4Ā, 7Ā (pres. खिन्न) 1. To be depressed, to suffer pain or misery, to be wearied, to feel tired or exhausted, ब्रूतां वाचमसूयको विषमुचं तस्मिन्न खिद्यामहे Sant.S.iii.7, स्वसुखनिरभिलाषः खिद्यसे लोकहेतोः Sak.v., Hit.ii., Bt.xiv.108, xvii.10; 2. to terrify.With परि-, to suffer pain or misery, to be distressed, to be wearied.
खिदिर m. 1. An ascetic; 2. a pauper; 3. the moon.
